correctness.rationale: For trees on >=3 vertices, degree>=2 is a 3-variable spine predicate. Recycled variable names express exact spine-walk distances of any fixed length in FO³ and a k-leaf threshold at a given center in FO^k: witness k-1 distinct leaf neighbors, rebind center name to kth leaf and release one stored name to a common neighbor of that leaf and the stored first leaf, forcing the former center. Hence each finite clipped spine word/length/reversal type has a width-k defining sentence. Conversely an indefinite k-pebble strategy matches spine vertices under reversal and distinct leaves fiberwise; if both fibers >=k, there is always a fresh leaf since <=k-1 other pebbles are placed. Burnside on reversal gives N_k(1)=k-1 and N_k(m)=[k²(k+1)^(m-2)+k(k+1)^floor((m-1)/2)]/2 for m>=2. Witness increase b=k to k+1 for lower defining width; FO² is by two-pebble adjacency/equality options. Independently checked finite orbit counts and leaf thresholds. Finite games are only corroboration.
